claims.claim_en: Root: خ-ل-ق (kh-l-q) meaning 'to create, bring into existence.'

claims.claim_ar: اشتقاق بالمشتق الفاعل على وزن (فَاعِل): خَالِق من خَلَقَ، دال على الفاعلية والموصوف بالصفة الفاعلية
claims.claim_en: Pattern: the active-participle form 'خَالِق' (pattern fa'il) is derived from خَلَقَ, showing an agentive/ongoing aspect of the root.

claims.claim_ar: الجذر: أ-ج-ل؛ معنى الاسم: أجل - وقت محدد أو أجل مسمّى (مدة/موعد محدد)
claims.claim_en: Root: أ-ج-ل (ʼ-j-l) meaning 'ajal' — an appointed term or fixed time/limit (a set deadline/term).

warnings: Some claims are supported by derived forms found in the commentary (e.g., the participle 'خالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ') rather than the exact surface word in the ayah (خَلَقَكُمْ).
No sourced commentary substrings were found for several ayah words (قَضَى, مُسَمَّىً, عِنْدَهُ, تَمْتَرُونَ) in the provided chunks, so morphology claims for those words were not extracted.
